summary: Czech Republic resident, former Red Hat employee, technical writer, extensive experience in IT support and systems administration, strong interest in Linux and open-source software, expertise in operating systems (especially Unix-like systems), avid user of vintage computing systems (e.g., Amiga, RISC OS), critical of corporate practices in tech (especially Microsoft), engaged in discussions about climate change and environmental issues, former London resident, no dependents, enjoys writing and blogging, has a background in teaching English as a foreign language (TEFL).
